args.name: moss-bedding-trial
args.function: Construct and evaluate a small recoverable moss resting pad, if supported by actual material and resting mechanics; specify a reusable interface with inspection, interruption and removal behavior.
args.conditions: Sol owns 0.9 moss near the observed moss source. A press trial at load 0.3 returned held=false and flexibility=0.8. This does not establish insulation, cleanliness, bedding feasibility or comfort. Use an unoccupied reachable site and require actual material and work; report unsupported effects rather than simulating success.
args.inputs: Owned moss and a suitable reachable site; required quantity, any additional materials and tools are unknown. Do not grant missing resources.
args.costs: Unknown; specify material requirements, learning time, work, energy, and cancellation or recovery costs before execution.
args.effects: If physically supported, create a persistent resting pad whose actual effects can be tested against ordinary rest. Preserve uncertainty about health, warmth and comfort until measured. If unsupported, explain the missing mechanics without claiming construction or benefits.

candidates.function: Plant one owned root unit in a small soil plot as a persistent trial, inspect a plot by direct observation, or take back remaining planted material; resume or cancel unfinished planting.
candidates.costs: Plant: one owned unspoiled root unit (quantity 1); two work rounds at one energy each, at an unoccupied ordinary-soil x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; supply inputStackId. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: one round and 0.2 energy, the baseline probe observation of a plot in reach (target). Remove: one round and 1 energy, planter only (target). Tend is unavailable and spends nothing. No tools or water are granted.
candidates.effects: Completed planting places the real root unit in the plot; it keeps ageing under existing environmental decay while the planter is absent. Plot state records stage, observation rounds, soil moisture and temperature/rain exposure. There is no propagation, growth, harvest or replenishment rule for roots, so a plot never produces food. Inspect records only visible state. Remove returns only the material that physically remains, never a replacement; the emptied plot remains. Cancel releases unplanted material once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for planting, inspecting or removing; genuine observed changes use the existing evidence-deduplicated probe feedback only.

candidates.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
candidates.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

candidates.function: Place one or two whole units of an owned food on the ground as a paired exposure trial, inspect their quantity and decay, end the observation or retrieve what remains.
candidates.costs: Start: inputStackId of an owned, unspoiled, nontoxic food, quantity 1 or 2 whole units (default 2), and an unoccupied ordinary-ground x/y within 0.65 plus body radius; two work rounds at one energy each. Resume/cancel use personal processId. Inspect: target trial in reach, one round and 0.2 energy. Retrieve: operator only, one round and one energy. Cancel of an exposed trial ends observation at no cost. No supports, tools, water or fuel are used or granted.
candidates.effects: Completed setup places the samples at two ground positions 0.2 apart under the same ambient conditions; with one unit there is no matched control. No food moisture, drying or preservation model exists in this world: both samples keep the existing decay rules, so no treatment difference, preserved status, safety certification or extended lifetime is produced. The trial records rounds exposed and marks a 10-round observation checkpoint; ageing continues while unattended and after the checkpoint. Inspect records sample quantity and decay as a personal unverified record. Retrieve returns only the remaining material, never a replacement. Setup interruption keeps paid work; cancel releases reserved food once; death releases it on the ground. Spent effort is never refunded. No reward for starting, inspecting or retrieving.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"sol\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"The searched registry covers gathering, dropping, observation, sample trials and ordinary rest, but not a persistent recoverable loose-material resting-pad trial. Cultivate-plant and controlled-food-processing-trial have different inputs and effects; their process-management code can be reused, not represented as a new invention. Develop a general loose-material pad trial, initially supporting owned moss as a recoverable ground arrangement. This is a feasible precursor, not certification of bedding. The failed load test does not rule out a ground-supported loose arrangement, but establishes neither body support nor insulation, cleanliness or comfort.\",\"specification\":\"Current-conversation development handoff: implement a general operation named arrange-resting-material with modes arrange, inspect, trial-rest, remove, resume and cancel. Parameters are mode, inputStackId, quantity, x/y, target and processId as applicable; do not bind it to Sol, this stack or this source. Initially admit moss only for loose, ground-supported placement; additional materials require explicit implemented applicability rules. Prerequisites: individual study after implementation, an actually reachable unoccupied ordinary-ground site within 0.65 plus body radius, ownership and physical access to the selected stack, and enough energy for each work step. Check occupancy and ownership again at commit. This grants no movement, tools, harvesting, ownership of a site or missing materials. No frame, binding or elevated load support is required or claimed.\\nArrange accepts positive quantities in 0.1-unit increments, minimum 0.1, default 0.5, limited by actual available input. It creates a small loose-material trial patch, not a guaranteed body-sized bed. Use a 0.25-radius placement footprint for occupancy and rendering only; do not infer thickness, coverage, body fit or comfort from quantity. Setup takes two active work rounds at one energy per completed round, with the selected real quantity reserved once. Commit transfers that surviving quantity into one persistent patch; it does not duplicate or consume it as fuel. No tools, water, branches or additional material are supplied. If the ground-placement prerequisite cannot be implemented, return the precise unsupported operation and leave material unchanged rather than display a constructed pad. Development and review waiting consume no world time.\\nInspect takes one round and 0.2 energy at reach, delegating existing probe observation semantics. Report visible placement, remaining quantity, occupancy and recorded tests; material quality and unknown properties stay unknown. It cannot infer sanitation, warmth, insulation or suitability. Trial-rest requires a completed nearby patch, the actor actually at its location, and no other occupant. It executes exactly one existing rest action: one round, base energy recovery 4 modified only by actually accessible registered facilities and capped at 40. Do not register this loose patch as a beneficial facility. Record actual pre/post energy, elapsed round, relevant accessible facility modifiers and patch identity. An ordinary-ground reference uses the same operation with no patch target, with independent movement required if needed. A comparison may report observed differences and confounders, not causal comfort or health findings. Never bypass rest's existing hunger, environmental or other simulation updates. Extra inspections are separate paid actions. The actor independently chooses whether to rest or compare; do not manufacture participation.\\nRemove requires the placing actor, reach and an unoccupied patch; it takes one round and one energy and returns only its remaining material to an owned stack at that site, not remotely into inventory. Pickup remains a separate existing action. Removal deletes the empty patch and ends its trial, retaining evidence records. It produces no replacement moss or clean-material certification. Record constituent stack provenance, quantity and any existing applicable ageing or material-state rules. While unattended the patch persists and participates in applicable existing ground/environment updates; elapsed time alone grants no benefit or replenishment. Do not invent decay or contamination rates. No ongoing energy charge, growth, automatic rest or comfort aura exists. Maintenance in this minimal version is inspection followed, if desired, by paid removal and rearrangement of surviving material; there is no free repair or automatic top-up.\\nEach process stores operator, resolved input IDs, site, reserved surviving quantity, completed work rounds, paid energy, status and idempotent transfer markers. Interruption pauses unfinished setup with completed work retained and no passive progress or energy expenditure; resume revalidates access and site and pays only unfinished steps. Cancel releases surviving escrow once as owned ground material at the work site; completed patches instead require removal. Death stops active work, releases surviving escrow once onto the ground and leaves a completed patch physically present under existing death/ownership rules, without fabricating an heir or permission. Atomic inspect, removal and rest apply only on completed executions; interrupted unpaid/uncommitted effects are absent, and any committed material transfer must not repeat. Spent rounds, energy, consumed material from separate probes and real environmental losses are never refunded. Global pause preserves state.\\nExact references: rest, equivalence base:rest:1, handler forest.rest, revision foundation-forest@1; probe, equivalence open-baseline:probe:1; cultivate-plant, equivalence cultivation:root-trial:plant-inspect-remove:1; controlled-food-processing-trial, equivalence food:paired-ground-exposure:observation-trial:1; and existing navigate, pickup, gather and learn for their own actions. Record reused process, escrow, observation and rest handlers in implementation provenance. It is not an unperformed bedding test. Sol's candidate input is item-37-sol-183, 0.9 moss at the recorded location, from forest-moss-2; validate current access and surviving quantity at execution. Do not debit or harvest the source's observed stock automatically. The default setup would transfer 0.5 and leave 0.4 in the original stack if unchanged; removal can recover no more than what remains in the patch.\",\"learning\":3,\"experienceReview\":\"Three study rounds are required individually after implementation; review grants no mastery. Minimal implementation adds no new experience award: genuine new observations, including informative failures, may use only the existing probe evidence-deduplication path with its implemented personal applicability, bounded awards, cooldown and decay. If that path lacks an applicable rule, award zero rather than invent one. Rechecking the known failed press or repeatedly resting on unchanged moss is not new verified information. Physical recovery is the actual rest effect, not an experience reward. No comfort increase is supported; physical comfort remains subject to its cap of 10. No mood adjustment reduces basic nutrition needs, and no protected reward account, budget, goal or permission changes.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable events only for committed transitions: work started/progressed/paused/resumed/cancelled, material placed, inspection recorded, rest completed and remaining material recovered.
